issues.description: The section recommends sending tabular student data (including Jméno) to a model but does not include an explicit instruction to anonymize/pseudonymize or otherwise filter PII before sending to external models. Given institutional GDPR/privacy guidance in the memory (Filtrování PII), this is a substantive omission that affects safe use.
issues.required_fix: Add an explicit paragraph instructing users to remove or mask personally identifiable information (names, IDs, email addresses, sensitive scores) before sending data to external/cloud models, reference the repository's PII filtering guidance (Filtrování PII) and point readers to DPIA / anonymization templates in the appendix (9.3.3).

This makes direct verification of those footnoted claims impossible from the provided retrieval set.
issues.required_fix: Either (a) include the page_21 excerpts in the KB retrievals so the footnotes can be verified, or (b) replace/augment those footnotes with currently-available KB citations (e.g., where the same prompt text appears in the prior section excerpt).

issues.description: The LaTeX body uses verbatim environments inside an itemize environment. Depending on the LaTeX class and packages used, verbatim inside itemize can cause compilation issues or awkward spacing.
issues.required_fix: Replace verbatim environments inside itemize with a safe alternative: either (a) move the code blocks outside the itemize as separate paragraphs, or (b) use the Verbatim environment from the fancyvrb package (\begin{Verbatim} ... \end{Verbatim}) or lstlisting from listings, and ensure the preamble loads the needed package. Add a note to test compile the file.

issues.description: The subsection 'Užitečné prompt‑vzory' is labeled '(general background knowledge)' but contains actionable prompt templates. It's unclear which templates are sourced from the KB and which are the author's general suggestions.
issues.required_fix: Explicitly mark each prompt that is directly taken from the KB (with a footnote to the exact page/chunk) and label any templates that are author-created as 'general background knowledge' or provide a sourcing footnote. Alternatively, remove the parenthetical label and add per-item sourcing notes.

issues.description: The section recommends CSV/JSON outputs for LMS import but does not provide a small concrete example of a CSV header or a JSON schema for the feedback use case, which would improve usability for teachers implementing the workflow.
issues.required_fix: Add one short example CSV header and a minimal JSON object illustrating how feedback rows map to LMS fields (e.g., columns and a sample record). If such examples are not directly present in the KB, mark them as practical (author) examples or obtain supporting KB text.
